scope: Native ten-sample C0/CT replicate-0 features and preprocessing-only CS; no fitting or scoring
storage_note: Hardlink shared BAMs under ordered unique names; copy only cross-filesystem BAMs/indexes (sample 0 about 4.8 GB). Features expected below 2 GB; 15 GB is provisioning headroom, not a scientific limit.
runtime_note: Unmeasured ten-sample native extraction, especially COMEBin bedGraph processing; 10 hours at 4 vCPU is a failure ceiling, not an expected duration.
review_boundary: Review all feature axes, masks, zeros, CS differences, native logs and measured resource cost before paired seed-11 fitting. Keep native schedules unchanged.
